note: Candidate compile-time options for growing the model. Each one is screened alone (scripts/screen_options.py) before it may enter the ACTS model. 'probe' is Tcl run in testfixture; it must print 1 when the feature really works.

SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5.probe: db eval {CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE t USING fts5(x)}; puts 1

SQLITE_ENABLE_RTREE.probe: db eval {CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE t USING rtree(id,a,b)}; puts 1

SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS3.probe: db eval {CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE t USING fts3(x)}; puts 1

SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS4.probe: db eval {CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE t USING fts4(x)}; puts 1

SQLITE_ENABLE_STAT4.probe: db eval {CREATE TABLE a(x); CREATE INDEX ai ON a(x); INSERT INTO a VALUES(1); ANALYZE}; puts [db one {SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='sqlite_stat4'}]

SQLITE_ENABLE_DBSTAT_VTAB.probe: db eval {CREATE TABLE a(x)}; db eval {SELECT * FROM dbstat}; puts 1

SQLITE_ENABLE_UPDATE_DELETE_LIMIT.probe: db eval {CREATE TABLE a(x); INSERT INTO a VALUES(1),(2); DELETE FROM a LIMIT 1}; puts [expr {[db one {SELECT count(*) FROM a}] == 1}]

pairs_to_check.name: GEOPOLY without RTREE
pairs_to_check.why: geopoly code is inside ext/rtree/rtree.c behind #ifdef SQLITE_ENABLE_GEOPOLY

pairs_to_check.name: OMIT_WAL, then PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL
pairs_to_check.probe: set f /tmp/screen-wal-[pid].db; file delete -force $f; sqlite3 d2 $f; puts [d2 one {PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL}]; d2 close; file delete -force $f
